hierarchy_nodes.title: Choice to pursue other options
hierarchy_nodes.content:
8.05 Choice to pursue other options
This mechanism is to provide an additional window for resolution of
complaints/disputes to create confidence in business environment in the
country. Efforts would be made to resolve the complaints amicably and
expeditiously. However, this mechanism is only conciliatory in nature. The
aggrieved parties are free to pursue any other course of action including legal
action against the erring party. Disputes between two Indian parties or between
two foreign parties are not covered under this mechanism.
